message.content:
A medium-sized tomato (about 123 g) contains roughly **22 calories**.  
If you’re looking at a smaller cherry tomato, it’s about 5–7 calories per fruit, and a larger beefsteak tomato can be around 30–35 calories. The exact number can vary slightly depending on the variety and ripeness, but 20–25 calories per medium tomato is a good rule of thumb.
